step1_analysis.description: A fully symmetric differential OTA with a replica bias circuit (XM1_N, XM2_N, XM3_N) to set the output common-mode voltage. Although the paper metadata labels it as a VCO, the topology is clearly an OTA, likely used as the core building block for the 100-MHz bandpass filter mentioned in the title.

paper_reference.title: An Enhanced Adaptive Q-Tuning Scheme for a 100-MHz Fully Symmetric OTA-Based Bandpass Filter

sky130_expected.calculation: gm * Rout. gm ≈ 1 mS, Rout ≈ 32 kOhm -> Gain ≈ 32 V/V = 30 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Single-stage OTA gain is limited by the intrinsic gain of the transistors (gm/gds). In SKY130 at L=0.5u, 30-40 dB is typical.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm / (2 * pi * CL). gm ≈ 1 mS, CL = 100 fF -> GBW ≈ 1.5 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: To support a 100 MHz filter, the OTA GBW must be significantly higher, typically > 500 MHz.
A single-stage OTA with a dominant load capacitor typically has >60 degrees phase margin.
Based on the bias current required to achieve the necessary gm for high-frequency operation.

Slew_Rate.description: Maximum rate of change of the output voltage.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_tail / CL = 311 uA / 100 fF = 3.11 V/ns = 3110 V/us.
sky130_expected.reasoning: High slew rate is expected due to the large tail current and small load capacitance (100fF).

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for fully symmetric OTA. Uses 100Meg resistors for DC common-mode feedback to stabilize the operating point, and 1F capacitors to couple AC and Transient signals without disturbing the DC bias. Note: W_xm3_n is adjusted to 2.5u to properly balance the replica bias current with the differential pair.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Fully Symmetric OTA Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Note: W_xm3_n is set to 2.5u (half of W_xm3) so the replica branch carries I_tail/2.
* This current is mirrored 1:1 by the PMOS loads (XM2_1, XM2_2), perfectly balancing
* the differential pair which sinks I_tail/2 per branch.
.param W_xm1_n=5u L_xm1_n=0.5u
.param W_xm3_n=2.5u L_xm3_n=0.5u
.param W_xm1_2=5u L_xm1_2=0.5u
.param W_xm1_1=5u L_xm1_1=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm2_2=5u L_xm2_2=0.5u
.param W_xm2_n=5u L_xm2_n=0.5u
.param W_xm2_1=5u L_xm2_1=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VBIAS1 BIAS1 0 0.8

* DUT
XM1_N N2 N2 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1_n} w={W_xm1_n}
XM3_N N1 BIAS1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3_n} w={W_xm3_n}
XM1_2 VOUT_PLUS VIN_MINUS N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1_2} w={W_xm1_2}
XM1_1 VOUT_MINUS VIN_PLUS N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1_1} w={W_xm1_1}
XM3 N4 BIAS1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM2_2 VOUT_PLUS N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2_2} w={W_xm2_2}
XM2_N N2 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2_n} w={W_xm2_n}
XM2_1 VOUT_MINUS N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2_1} w={W_xm2_1}

* DC feedback for self-biasing (sets output CM to equilibrium)
Rfb1 VOUT_PLUS VIN_MINUS 100Meg
Rfb2 VOUT_MINUS VIN_PLUS 100Meg

* AC/Tran coupling
Cac1 IN_P VIN_PLUS 1
Cac2 IN_M VIN_MINUS 1

* Input sources
V_IN_P IN_P 0 DC 0 AC 0.5 PULSE(-0.1 0.1 1n 100p 100p 10n 20n)
V_IN_M IN_M 0 DC 0 AC -0.5 PULSE(0.1 -0.1 1n 100p 100p 10n 20n)

* Load capacitance
CL1 VOUT_PLUS 0 100f
CL2 VOUT_MINUS 0 100f

* Differential output
E_diff VOUT_DIFF 0 VOUT_PLUS VOUT_MINUS 1

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

ac dec 100 1Meg 10Gig
let gain_db = vdb(VOUT_DIFF)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(VOUT_DIFF))
meas ac dc_gain max gain_db
meas ac gbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac phase_at_gbw find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1
let pm = phase_at_gbw + 180
print pm

tran 10p 20n
meas tran vout_max max v(VOUT_DIFF)
meas tran vout_min min v(VOUT_DIFF)
meas tran t1_r when v(VOUT_DIFF)=-0.2 rise=1
meas tran t2_r when v(VOUT_DIFF)=0.2 rise=1
let sr_rise = 0.4 / (t2_r - t1_r)
print sr_rise

meas tran t1_f when v(VOUT_DIFF)=0.2 fall=1
meas tran t2_f when v(VOUT_DIFF)=-0.2 fall=1
let sr_fall = -0.4 / (t2_f - t1_f)
print sr_fall
quit
.endc
